ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 2.4 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.8, 2026-06-30: 0.8) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.6, 2025-06-30: 0.6)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged

dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: 4/4 quarters covered: the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 97.8M (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, filed 2026-08-07) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31
left_out: quarter ended 2026-06-30: the year-to-date facts decrease (2026-01-01..2026-03-31 = 97,842,000 > 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 97,841,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -1,000; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)
